# Salmon Pay

Salmon Pay creates one USDC payment request with a Solana Pay interface for people and, when the configured facilitator supports the selected network, an x402 v2 interface for software agents.

## Public documentation

- API reference: /docs
- Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 contract: /openapi.json
- Service health: /api/health
- Facilitator capabilities: /api/x402/status

## API conventions

Authenticated endpoints accept `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`. JSON responses use a top-level `data` or `error` envelope. Never send wallet seed phrases or private keys to Salmon Pay.

Payment requests are the aggregate root. Human Solana Pay and agent x402 settlement update the same request and produce the same immutable receipt and `payment.paid` event. Use `Idempotency-Key` when creating payments. Treat all IDs as opaque.
